verdict.rationale: Elastic Observability is a platform rather than an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server or endpoint. The natural-language telemetry interaction (elastic-docs-25), the AI SRE feature (elastic-docs-26) and the llms.txt probe are adjacent AI features, not a way to connect an external agent over MCP.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
